rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a budget traveler carrying a backpack.

example.english: At the station, we met a backpacker who planned to travel around Europe by train.
example.traditional: 我哋喺車站遇到一個背包客，佢打算搭火車遊歐洲。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hai2 ce1 zaam6 jyu6 dou3 jat1 go3 bui3 baau1 haak3 keoi5 daa2 syun3 daap3 fo2 ce1 jau4 au1 zau1

rows.note: Use this when referring to a hostel aimed at young or budget travelers rather than to the travelers themselves.

example.english: This youth hostel is cheap and ideal for a backpacker.
example.traditional: 呢間青年旅舍價錢平，最啱背包客住。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 cing1 nin4 leoi5 se3 gaa3 cin2 peng4 zeoi3 ngaam1 bui3 baau1 haak3 zyu6
